prompt:
Beat 2/4 of the LIN-4226 plan (still no code changes; same warm session). Your beat-1 grounding was good. Now settle the design and the inventory, and report them back as your recap; the plan text itself is beat 3.

1. Inventory: define the behaviour plainly ("a cost figure is computed from records the read itself obtained from the source; callers hand over the source, never rows") and find every place it lives. Do a repeatable search (give the exact rg/grep commands) for requestRows, forAnchors, forRows, lineageRecords, lineageFigureOf, lineageCost, readCost, readModelsHistory, collectWorkspaceKpis, buildRunView, and docs/tests that describe the old shape. For each hit say in-scope or out, with a reason and (if out) the ticket that handles it. Include the parallel paths: render-session.js, run-paragraph-hook.js, routes/settings.js, routes/dispatch.js, server.js /kpis wiring, scripts/*, tests, docs.
2. Design decisions, each with the reason and the alternatives set aside in a line: (a) what the read receives (the loader object? a narrower `{forAnchors, forRows}` source?) and what happens when it is missing, keeping LIN-4201's required-argument throw; (b) how entry points become async and which callers/call chains that ripples to; (c) how `/kpis` stays ONE instance-wide batched load (name where the single load happens and what stops a per-lineage query); (d) how a legitimate "no records" source is expressed for scripts and the replay; (e) how the replay harness S10/S11/S13 get rewired to pass the source and keep the diff against `tests/fixtures/cost-replay/lin4201-change-list.json` exact.
3. Witnesses: for each promised behaviour, a test that fails before the change and passes after. Specifically: a purity test with an injected fake source; a mutation witness (a caller or read path that bypasses the source must fail a test, e.g. a guard test that greps/asserts no forAnchors/forRows outside the loader and the read's entry path, plus a behavioural fake-source test that fails if a caller preloads); a /kpis test counting source calls (one batched load); the replay diff exact-match. Name the 2-3 likeliest ways the change breaks.
4. Session fit: say with specifics whether it fits one session, and whether plan-review is due (it touches a contract/guard, so reason about it honestly).
Use relative repo paths; verify facts at HEAD, not from memory. Post nothing to the description yet. Finish with a concise recap.
